home.title: Home
home.description: Guwahati Biotech Park is the first biotech park in Northeast India — ready-to-use labs, scientific facilities and incubation for bio-science ventures at Amingaon, Guwahati.

about.title: About
about.description: The story, vision, mission, leadership and research ecosystem of Guwahati Biotech Park, a joint initiative of the Government of Assam and DBT, Government of India, at Amingaon, Guwahati.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.description: Explore the Technology Incubation Centre, Regional Honey Testing Laboratory, Bioinformatics Facility, NIDHI PRAYAS, BICFA and training facilities at Guwahati Biotech Park, Amingaon.

incubation.title: Incubation
incubation.description: Apply for incubation at Guwahati Biotech Park. Ready-to-use modular labs, flexible leases, scientific support and business guidance for bio-ventures in Northeast India.

achievements.title: Achievements & Activities
achievements.description: Photos and videos from Guwahati Biotech Park — training programmes, laboratory development, outreach, innovation and incubatee milestones at the Amingaon campus.

news.title: News & Tenders
news.description: Tenders, quotations, training programmes, careers, events and news from Guwahati Biotech Park, with links to the official notices.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact Guwahati Biotech Park at Amingaon, Guwahati. Find the administration, scientific team, honey testing laboratory and directions to the campus.
